note: Triennial election, polled Thursday 1 June 1967. There were no contests: all sixteen seats were filled unopposed. The only change was in Castlegore, where E. C. H. Young took the place of the retiring Independent, J. T. Smyth. Returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
correctionNote: Renamed from 'Langfield' to Longfield (19 Nov 2026, w19-tidy, the owner's decision 4 of 19 Nov 2026: a division filed under two spellings takes its official name, and each round keeps the spelling it was filed under as Constituency_Name_As_Printed): the Northern Ireland DED maps of 1925-69 name the DED Longfield; the rounds were filed as Longfield (1930, 1933, 1936, 1939, 1949, 1952, 1955, 1958, 1961, 1964); Langfield (1967). This round was filed as 'Langfield', kept as Constituency_Name_As_Printed; the old address (langfield) answers with a redirect to this one.
